title: [Platform] Create RhinoHealth/ai-agents repo: npm workspaces, CI, ruleset
needs: G0: the rhino-ai-agents GitHub App (no bypass) and the fcp main ruleset as the pattern. G0's LLM gateway code also lives here. DevOps: ECR repos and runner-group access.
what: A new private repo, RhinoHealth/ai-agents, set up as one npm workspace in TypeScript on Node 24 (like Byte) for the orchestrator, broker, harness, Slack app, gateway and a shared package, with evals/ as a small Python project beside it. It gets CI (lint, typecheck, tests, image builds, a harness release) and a main ruleset.
why: Every G3 service, and G0's gateway, lives here. One workspace gives one lockfile, one CI and the same walls for all agent code.
how: Create the private repo RhinoHealth/ai-agents: TypeScript on Node 24, npm workspaces, ESM ("type": "module"), like Byte, so Byte's broker becomes the base of ours (G3-07). Workspaces shared/, gateway/, broker/, orchestrator/, harness/ and slack-app/ (checks/, metrics/ and drills/ come later), each `@rhinohealth/ai-agents-<pkg>` with src/*.ts in kebab-case and test/*.test.ts. tsconfig.base.json: strict, target ES2023, module and moduleResolution NodeNext, verbatimModuleSyntax. evals/ is its own small uv project (Python 3.13), because Harbor and its adapters are Python.

Follow Byte's style, not fcp's black/isort: ESLint with typescript-eslint (eslint.config.js), tsc, tests with node:test and node:assert/strict run through tsx, exact-pinned dependencies and few runtime ones. Only evals/ keeps fcp's Python style (black and isort at 120 columns, flake8 with select=F, through pre-commit).

.github/workflows/ci.yml on pull_request and push to main, runs-on fcp-runner-set, actions/setup-node (24, npm cache): job `lint` (`npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`), job `test` (`npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build`), and job `evals` (astral-sh/setup-uv, `uv sync --frozen --project evals`, pre-commit, `uv run --project evals pytest`). Ask DevOps to let the repo use the runner group.

images.yml on main: build the orchestrator, broker, gateway, slack-app and checks images (FROM node:24-bookworm-slim pinned by digest, `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, non-root user 10001, like Byte's Dockerfile) and push them to inf ECR. Add ai-agents-orchestrator, ai-agents-broker, ai-agents-slack-app and ai-agents-checks (the required checks, G0-09) to multi_tenant/accounts/infrastructure/artifacts/artifacts.hcl with tags_immutability_enabled = true (G0-15 adds ai-agents-llm-gateway the same way). release-harness.yml bundles harness/ with esbuild into one file, nova-worker.mjs (the shared package and every dependency inside, `#!/usr/bin/env node` on top). The harness imports the Agent SDK from `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/core`, the SDK's documented entry for bundled apps, and runs the image's pinned claude through pathToClaudeCodeExecutable, so the SDK's own binary isn't needed. The release attaches ai-agents-harness-<version>.tgz (nova-worker.mjs, workflows/, prompts/, settings/protected-paths.yaml); the Packer image unpacks it (G3-14) with nothing to install.
Ruleset on main: PR required, exactly 1 approval, dismiss stale approvals, required checks lint, test and evals, no force push or delete, no bypass for the rhino-ai-agents app. No CODEOWNERS file.
Add a short AGENTS.md (what lives where, how to run tests) and a CLAUDE.md that only says `@AGENTS.md`, like frontend/.

title: [DevOps] Add modules/aws-vpc-private: sandbox subnets with no route out
what: A private-only variant of modules/aws-vpc: private subnets in 3 AZs, no NAT, no internet gateway, flow logs always on, an S3 gateway endpoint that only reaches our buckets, and the interface endpoints a sandbox needs.
why: modules/aws-vpc always adds public subnets, a single NAT and public IPs on launch. A sandbox must have no way out except the egress proxy and our own services.
how: Copy modules/aws-vpc to modules/aws-vpc-private. Keep terraform-aws-modules/vpc 6.5.1; set public_subnets = [], create_igw = false, enable_nat_gateway = false, map_public_ip_on_launch = false.

Private subnets: three /18s cut from vpc_cidr (room for many VMs; the fourth /18 is left for the proxy's own subnets in G3-09). Flow logs always on, to the module's S3 bucket, with force_destroy = false and a 365-day expiry.
S3 gateway endpoint with a policy that allows only var.s3_allowed_buckets. The current module allows `*`, which would let a presigned URL to anyone's bucket work from inside.
Interface endpoints through terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws//modules/vpc-endpoints for var.interface_endpoints, with private DNS and a security group that allows 443 from the VPC only.
Outputs: vpc, private_subnets, endpoints_sg_id, flow_log_bucket. Run `tofu fmt -check` and `terragrunt hcl format --check` (what terrugrunt-lint.yml runs).

code.text:
# Private-only VPC for AI agent sandboxes: no IGW, no NAT, no public subnets.
# The only ways out are the egress proxy (G3-09) and PrivateLink to inf (G3-17).
module "vpc" {
  source  = "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws"
  version = "6.5.1"

  name            = local.vpc_name
  cidr            = var.vpc_cidr
  azs             = slice(data.aws_availability_zones.available.names, 0, 3)
  private_subnets = [for n in range(3) : cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 2, n)] # three /18s
  public_subnets  = []

  create_igw                = false
  enable_nat_gateway        = false
  map_public_ip_on_launch   = false
  enable_dns_hostnames      = true
  enable_flow_log           = true
  flow_log_destination_type = "s3"
  flow_log_destination_arn  = module.s3_bucket.s3_bucket_arn
  tags                      = var.tags
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3" {
  vpc_id            = module.vpc.vpc_id
  service_name      = "com.amazonaws.${var.aws_region}.s3"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"
  route_table_ids   = module.vpc.private_route_table_ids

  # Only our buckets: a presigned URL to someone else's bucket must not work from here.
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version   = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{ Effect = "Allow", Principal = "*", Action = ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
    Resource = [for b in var.s3_allowed_buckets : "arn:aws:s3:::${b}/*"] }]
  })
}
